catalog.summary: Month grid for choosing a date or a range.

valueType: PlainDate | PlainDate[] | { start: PlainDate | null, end: PlainDate | null } | null
focusModel: roving tabindex over the cells; exactly one cell in the tab sequence

wiring.abbr: the full weekday name on every column header
wiring.aria-disabled: an unavailable date, which stays focusable

keyboard.to: first day of the displayed week
last day of the displayed week

keyboard.onlyWhen: the view is month or year

announce.headingChange: polite, from the heading's own live region
announce.clampedStep: polite, naming the date a short month pulled the day back to

outsideDays: shown with one month, hidden with more

marks: marks, keyed by ISO date, draws a mark part inside that day: a dot in the row today's dot reserves, in the mark's tone (accent, info, success, warning, danger; the day's ink when chosen), and a visually hidden ', N items' (markCount) or ', has items' (marked) after the number, so the day's accessible name says it. It composes with every selection mode, min, max and outsideDays; a hidden outside day draws none

container.name: slotted-calendar
container.reflow: the cell is 100cqi divided by the columns, bounded above by the control height and below by --slotted-target-min, so it shrinks continuously rather than at a step; a second month that no longer fits wraps under the first rather than being withdrawn; below 320px the months close up one space step
container.why: A literal threshold cannot be right at three densities: seven comfortable columns are 238px and seven dense ones 182px, so any number that fits one shrinks the other while it still had room. CSS forbids a custom property in a container condition, which is what makes the arithmetic the answer and the query the exception.

dataAttributes.data-today: the day the reader's own zone is on, marked apart from selection
dataAttributes.data-outside-month: a day belonging to the month either side
dataAttributes.data-range-start: the first date of a range
dataAttributes.data-range-end: the last date of a range
dataAttributes.data-preview: beside one of the three range attributes: the band runs to the pending end, not to a chosen one
dataAttributes.data-view: which of day, month or year the calendar is showing

preview.pendingEnd: in range mode, while the run has one end: the day under the pointer, or the focused day when no pointer is over the grid
preview.notAModel: a fact the grid states, like onViewChange; the consumer does not own it

literals.--slotted-calendar-cell-size: A cell is square and its side is the control height, so a day reads to the same rhythm as the buttons above it; the family divides the room it has by the columns it draws and bounds the result by that height and by --slotted-target-min, which is arithmetic over tokens rather than a literal.
literals.columnCounts: 7, 4 and 4 are the column counts of the three views. They are the shape of a week and of a page of months, not a value a theme retunes, so they are written in the stylesheet as numbers.
